Topics covered in this PDF

BPCG-171 (General Psychology) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • The nervous system and nerve impulse, theories of motivation, theories of intelligence, Gestalt principles, models of memory
  • Work and organisation, perception, theories of emotions, thinking, Jean Piaget's theory

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: three assignments, answer all questions, total marks 100, assignment code Asst /TMA /2026-27. Assignment I: two questions of 20 marks (about 500 words each). Assignment II: three questions of 10 marks (about 250 words each). Assignment III: five questions of 6 marks (about 100 words each)

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
